name: A Meal Served Cold
objectiveText: Kill a Cold Eye Basilisk, get a Chilled Basilisk Haunch , and return it to Angus Stern in the Blue Recluse. <You must not release your spirit to succeed in this quest.> Chilled Basilisk Haunch  ( 1 )

comments.body: When you accept the quest, you get a 30 minute timer.  It takes about four minutes to fly the Stormwind to Booty Bay route, and the Cold-Eye Basilisks are along the road and on the west shore in the middle of Stranglethorn.
replies: Got the drop on first kill, and so had 16 minutes on the clock after hearthing back to stormwind. Even had a moment to resurrect a gnome that died in the city for some reason.

Done this quest as Mage 37. Very easy - set your Hearth in Booty Bay (done it, since BB is a great hub to quickly travel on both continents). Steps: 1. get the quest in SW. 2.hearth to Booty Bay 3. run to 34.40 kill the Basilisk and get the Haunch. 4. as a mage, teleport back to SW. All it takes 5 min.

comments.body:
I don't know if it was a recent patch, but it seems the concept of abandoning the quest and handing in the quest item is no longer valid.

I started the quest, ignoring the time, got the meat and returned to Stormwind. After I abandoned the quest, I found the quest item in my inventory missing. I thought I threw it away on accident, so I did the quest again only to find it missing for the second time. So, I'm assuming it has to be done the proper way now. /sad
replies: this is corrrect, a recent patch now deletes quest items if you abandon the quest.
This is still the case in classic. The meat disappears if the quest is abandoned. :)
As said below, if you fail the quest, but have the meat ... DO NOT ABANDON! ... go to quest giver and he'll give you the quest again, then turn in meat.

comments.body: Make sure you have your hearthstone up before you try this quest.  As a warrior without a mount it took me 15 minutes to go from the quest giver to Booty Bay (BB) and run from the griff trainer in BB to the spot where the mobs spawn.
200 Faction with Stormwind at lvl 40.

So in Classic, the quest item disappear if you abandon the quest. BUT, you can retake the quest if it's failed, without abandoning it, and that way the quest item will still be in the inventory, and you can hand it in.

this mob is located at 34,40.
i was lvl 40 and this quest gave me 4700ep :)

As much as I’ve traveled that road in STV I never noticed the cold eye basilisks before.  For clarification, they are just [b]north of Gurubashi arena on the road.[/b]

Traveling from booty Bay, just after you exit the arena on the road, you will see a basilisks on the right (wrong kind) and perhaps a tiger on the left. The next critter up the road will be your cold eye basilisks.
Without using my recalls I flew from SW to Booty Bay (6.5 minutes), road my mount and returned the same way. Completed the quest in 20 minutes (+ or – a few). 4700 xp at level 40. 
Fun little quest.

At level 45, this quest gave me 4700 xp. In addition, the quest gives 1.5g, which makes the 15 or so minutes to do it really worth it. With the cosmos addon, the change in reputation is as follows: Darnassus .007, Gnomeregan .0037, IF .0037, and SW .0096. These are rounded values, and one complete reputation rank is equal to 1 I believe.
If this quest seems not to be available to you, make sure you're not in another timed quest (in my case, the timer was already running for [quest=1119]).
Just find the Basilisks on the road north of the arena, to the west of the shadowmaws - its easier and faster than going behind the arena through the raptors.

I started the quest and looted the basilisk haunch as described above, then did a couple other quests and let the timer run out.  When I returned to the quest-giver and abandoned the quest, intending to re-accept it, the haunch of basilisk vanished too. I had to do the whole thing over again.
It is correct.  If you abandon the quest, the item is removed from your inventory.  Of course, I didn't try mailing it to another character or anything tricky like that.
replies: quest items are Soulbound, this would not work.

I took the meat, stoned back and turned in the quest for the gold and the great experience. Easy to do and good money and exp. (Watch for stealth panthers)
I found the drop at 37.40 in STV. Just to be on the safe side... Make your home at SW and fly to BB and then go from there. I did it in 10 minutes from getting the quest :)

Sooooo, I brought the haunch to Stormwind.  Cancelled and regrabbed the quest and just handed over the haunch I already got.  Quest completed!  :) 
My hearthstone was set for Booty Bay, so I had no teleport tunnels to worry about.

got this on the 1st drop and got myself 4700xp and 200 SW rep increase!

Did this in a group of three level 35 Paladins. You must each accept the quest individually, it does not start as a group like escort quests do, however the quest item is group loot so you'll only have to find and kill one Cold Eye Basilisk. Also, there is more than one type of basilisk in the area so don't waste time killing the wrong ones.

It took about 1:45 to run from the Blue Recluse to the flight master in Stormwind.
It took about 4:15, or 6 total minutes from when I started the timer until I landed in Booty Bay.
It took about 4:00, or about 10 total minutes from starting the timer to run to the Gurubashi Arena area (they spawn immediately North, North West and North East of the arena).

We were able to kill a level 40 Cold Eye Basilisk then hearth back and do the turn-in before 15 of the 30 minutes had run off.

Took me 11 minutes with 60% mount (Warlock lvl 40, had to summon Voidwalker, that's an extra 10 seconds).

Remember that you can not die and resurrect at the Spirit Healer!
If you die the meat is reported to be lost, so that's not a viable option!
Do not mount before you get to the tunnel, you will be dismounted when you ride on wood-floor!

Bind your hearthstone in Stormwind.
Get the quest
[ol]
[li]Ride to the Flight master 1:10[/li]
[li]Take flight to Booty Bay 4:10[/li]
[li]Ride to 39/41 3:35[/li]
[li]Kill the Cold Eye Basilisk (there are Stranglethorn Tigress' in the same area) ~0:30[/li]
[li]Hearth to Stormwind 0:10[/li]
[li]Run back to the quest giver 0:50[/li]
[/ol]

[ul]
[li]Experience 4700.[/li]
[li]Stormwind reputation 200.[/li]
[li]Awarded 1 gold 50 silver.[/li]
[/ul]
Friendly reminder, you can die during this quest if you get ressed before your auto release timer is up.
